description: PTAL (Public Transport Accessibility Level) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Public Transport Accessibility Level (PTAL) is a measure of connectivity by public transport and is used for various planning processes. PTAL suggests how well a place is connected to public transport services. It does not cover trips by car. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023. It offers 8 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
